hero.description: Scan your receipts with artificial intelligence, manage your expenses smartly, and export detailed reports. All in one app.

items.title: AI Scanner
items.description: Scan receipts and invoices with artificial intelligence. Automatic data extraction: merchant, date, total, and items.

items.title: Expense Management
items.description: Organize your expenses by categories, tags, and payment methods. View statistics and spending trends.

items.title: Flexible Export
items.description: Export your data in PDF or CSV format. Share reports with your accountant or team easily.

items.title: Multi-Currency
items.description: Support for multiple currencies with automatic conversion. Ideal for travelers and international businesses.
